caption: The drawing is rendered in shades of gray on a beige paper background and depicts a single, ornate vessel, likely a creamer or pitcher, centrally positioned. The vessel has a tall, elegantly curved spout and a long, sweeping handle extending high above its rim on the left side. The body of the vessel is oval-shaped, tapering down to a narrow base, which rests atop a two-stepped square plinth. Both the rim and the base of the vessel feature a decorative beaded or dotted border. There is subtle ornamentation in the form of delicate patterns etched on the body near the spout. In the lower left corner, there is a decorative, oval-shaped monogram featuring the letter “A,” surrounded by a curling bow and dotted lines. The drawing is signed “H. NARALIAN” in the bottom right corner. The composition is contained within a lightly drawn rectangular border.
title: Silver Creamer
